args.description: raises the sword to the sky with both hands and holds it, then points it down at the ground ahead. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves him), always facing right, seen from the side; keep his look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what he holds: no glow, no flash, no sparks, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground; the whole body, the weapon and any trail stay inside the picture.
args.subject_description: a young man with messy white hair and blue eyes, a long white coat with grey tails, a black shirt, black trousers and grey boots, holding a white and gold sword with white ribbons
args.initial_pose: fighting stance facing right, holding a white and gold sword with white ribbons
